# Steamworks.NET

Version: 2025.164.1, Windows x64 standalone assemblies.
Source: https://github.com/rlabrecque/Steamworks.NET
Release: https://github.com/rlabrecque/Steamworks.NET/releases/tag/2025.164.1
Archive SHA-256: 9412348cc404563be5a43a28347cfeda3c679ee044a14d87a507ed2d796a537d

Downloaded and checked against the GitHub release asset digest on 2026-10-25.
Only Steamworks.NET.dll, steam_api64.dll and the included LICENSE.txt are retained.
The game-specific Steam application ID is supplied only to the short-lived join helper process.
No steam_appid.txt, Steam credentials or user tokens are shipped.

Steamworks.NET is used for the Steam lobby join bridge. Steam and Squad must be installed by the user.
Steamworks.NET wrapper licensing is in LICENSE.txt; Steam and Steamworks remain Valve products.
